verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents running entirely on the user's computer with no data leaving the device, and offers free self-hosting. That keeps user data away from any vendor and so effectively prevents it from being used for model training. The evidence never states a no-training policy or offers a training opt-out, and hosted or cloud-API setups ("Just bring an LLM API Key") may send data to third-party LLM providers without documented training guarantees. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training data-use policy or opt-out control, training guarantees for hosted and cloud-LLM configurations, and independent verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: A private AI assistant that runs entirely on your computer.
Every document becomes part of your agent's knowledge base with no data leaving your device.
